question: 'The Inheritance of Loss’ book is written by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kiran Desai.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kiran Desai** is an Indian author who was born in **New Delhi in 1971.**
 
• She is the daughter of **Anita Desai,** who is also a well-known author.
 
• **'The Inheritance of Loss'** is a novel written by Kiran Desai and was published in **2006.**
 
• The novel won the** Man Booker Prize** for Fiction in the same year.
 
• The novel tells the story of an **Indian judge living in Kalimpong**, a town in the Himalayan foothills, and his granddaughter who comes to live with him.
 
• The story deals with themes of **identity, exile, and the clash of cultures.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **VS Naipaul **is a Trinidadian-British author who won the **Nobel Prize for Literature in 2001. **
 
• **Ruskin Bond** is an Indian author who is known for his works on **nature and the Himalayas. **
 
• **Salman Rushdie** is a British-Indian author who is known for his controversial novel '**The Satanic Verses'.**
